_mode: SHADOW by default. The P2 order path is compiled in but DISARMED unless enable_order_path=true AND every order_* key below is present and in range.
_order_path_note: Set true ONLY to trade live. Requires oms_id (must match the running tsLtpShmOms node_config_details.oms_id), and all of order_notional_usd / max_position_notional_usd / price_tick / qty_step / cross_pct / quote_stale_ns. Missing key => refuses to arm. dry_run=true overrides.
